posts.title: Mark Twain in the Hill Country
posts.description: It took me twenty-one years, three months, and eleven days to realize my wife Nicole doesn’t talk as much as I thought. This revelation occurred to me on a drive back from a trip to the Austin area. She is quietly reading the news on her phone while I expound about our most recent visit with book collector Kevin Mac Donnell and his wife Donna. I’ve known them for over thirty years. posts.title: Runnin’ Down the Road
posts.description: I’m runnin’ down the road to the Houston Book Show, the morning traffic making me bleary-eyed. I’ve got seven book acquisitions on my mind, four I wanna own, two I’ll leave alone, one that is extremely fine. I ease into the parking lot with books and music filling much of the space in my head.
